config.title: Guy's Moving Sale
config.subtitle: We're moving out of New York — furniture, lighting and a few odds and ends, all looking for a new home.
config.note: Pickup only, from the apartment in New York. First come, first served. Cash, Venmo or Zelle. Happy to do a deal on bundles — take the whole living room and I'll make it worth your while.

items.title: Blue sectional sofa with chaise
items.description: Modern fabric sectional in teal-blue with a left-facing chaise and black tapered metal legs. Deep seat, loose back cushions. No visible stains or tears in the photos. Pillows not included.

items.title: Light oak media console / TV stand
items.description: Wide low console in pale oak with four drawers and a fluted centre cabinet with a diamond motif. Plenty of storage for media and toys. Roughly 70 inches wide.

items.title: Upholstered platform bed, rust orange
items.description: Wingback-style upholstered headboard in a warm rust fabric on a matching platform frame with dark wood legs. Looks like a queen. Ask whether the mattress is included.

items.title: Grey upholstered armchair
items.description: Compact club-style armchair in light grey with an exposed wood-tone frame and a loose seat cushion. Comfortable reading chair, clean upholstery.

items.title: Electric standing desk
items.description: Height-adjustable sit-stand desk with a warm wood top and a white steel frame. Around 55-60 inches wide. Motor and controller included.

items.title: Oak side table with drawer
items.description: Rounded-corner side table in pale oak with one drawer and an open lower shelf. Sits nicely next to a sofa.

items.title: Set of 3 framed abstract prints
items.description: Three large graphic prints in slim black frames — blue and red stripes, an orange and teal landscape, and a black dash pattern. Sold as a set.

items.title: Large living room rug
items.description: Big flatweave area rug in cream with a soft grey grid and stripe pattern. Sized to sit under the sectional.

items.title: Oak nightstand, two drawers
items.description: Scandinavian-style bedside table in light oak with two drawers and tapered legs.

items.title: Nesting side tables, set of 2
items.description: Pair of pebble-shaped nesting tables with light wood legs — one white top, one charcoal. Use them together or apart.

items.title: 27-inch computer monitor
items.description: Widescreen monitor on an adjustable stand, used with the standing desk. Ask Guy for the exact model and age.

items.title: Striped runner rug
items.description: Flatweave rug in grey and white stripes, currently under the desk.

items.title: Wood tripod floor lamp
items.description: Tall lamp on a light wood tripod base with a large cream drum shade. Warm, even light.

items.title: Mesh office chair
items.description: Beige mesh-back task chair with armrests, height adjustment and castors. Some light marks on the seat.

items.title: Brushed nickel floor lamp
items.description: Slim metal floor lamp with a large white drum shade — the one beside the armchair.

items.title: Adjustable metal floor lamp
items.description: Nickel-finish reading lamp with a jointed arm and a domed shade, IKEA Ranarp style. Swings out over a sofa or chair.

items.title: Wood tripod table lamp
items.description: Small tripod lamp in light wood with a linen drum shade. Matches the larger tripod floor lamp.

items.title: Brass desk lamp
items.description: Adjustable brass-finish desk lamp with a dome shade, vintage bankers style.

items.title: Green table lamp
items.description: Small dark green table lamp with an uplit cylinder shade. Currently on the bedside tray table.

items.title: White storage drawer unit
items.description: Rolling plastic drawer cart with six shallow drawers, used beside the desk.

items.title: Round tray side table
items.description: Grey metal side table with a removable round tray top, IKEA Gladom style. Used as a nightstand.

items.title: Small wood and linen table lamp
items.description: Compact bedside lamp with a turned wood base and a small drum shade.

items.title: IKEA Antilop high chair
items.description: The classic white high chair with a tray and removable support cushion. Wipes clean, easy to disassemble.

items.title: Large flat-screen TV (approx. 65 inch)
items.description: Big flat-screen TV, currently on the media console. Price on request — ask Guy for the brand, model and age before you make an offer.
